model_annotations.Bulgarian: Тази фигура (Figure 4) представя три линейни диаграми, обозначени като (a), (b) и (c), които илюстрират криви на обучение за метода SRPO и базови модели. Всяка от трите диаграми съдържа три линии, съответстващи на три метода, обозначени в легендата като GRPO (синя), SRPO (червена) и SRPO w/o Self-reflection SFT (зелена). Хоризонталната ос и на трите диаграми е етикетирана като „Train/Global Steps" и обхваща диапазон приблизително от 50 до 300, с равномерни интервали на 50 стъпки. В диаграма (a), озаглавена „Train/Reward", вертикалната ос представя стойности на наградата при обучение, обхващащи диапазон приблизително от 0.5 до 1.0, с интервали от 0.1. Трите линии показват колебания по протежение на стъпките, като червената и зелената линия се движат в по-високи области на скалата в сравнение със синята линия, която остава предимно в по-ниската част. В диаграма (b), озаглавена „Train/Response Length", вертикалната ос представя дължина на отговора и обхваща диапазон приблизително от 500 до 900, с интервали от 100. Червената линия (SRPO) се намира в най-горната част на диапазона, достигайки стойности около 800–900, зелената линия заема средна позиция, а синята линия остава в по-ниската част, около 500–600. В диаграма (c), озаглавена „Train/Ratio Clip Upper", вертикалната ос представя горна граница на съотношението на отрязване и обхваща диапазон от приблизително 0.002 до 0.014, с интервали от 0.002. Синята линия показва значителни колебания с пикове, достигащи до около 0.012–0.014, зелената линия също показва вариации, макар и по-умерени, а червената линия остава сравнително по-ниска и по-гладка в долната част на скалата. Линиите и на трите диаграми показват характерни за процеса на обучение колебания, като не са визуално подчертани чрез допълнителни анотации или маркери.
model_annotations.Chinese:
This figure presents three side-by-side line charts labeled (a), (b), and (c), collectively titled "Figure 4: Training curves for SRPO and baselines: (a) training reward, (b) response length, and (c) upper clipping ratio." Each chart tracks three methods over training progress, with the horizontal axis in all three labeled "Train/Global Steps" ranging from approximately 50 to 300, with tick marks at 50, 100, 150, 200, 250, and 300. The three methods are distinguished by color and indicated in a shared legend at the top of each subplot: GRPO shown in blue, SRPO shown in orange/red, and SRPO w/o Self-reflection SFT shown in green.

In chart (a), "Train/Reward," the vertical axis ranges from approximately 0.5 to 1.0, with tick marks at 0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, and 1.0. All three curves begin near 0.5–0.6 and generally trend upward. The SRPO (orange/red) and SRPO w/o Self-reflection SFT (green) curves rise more steeply and reach higher values, fluctuating around 0.9–1.0 by the end of training, while the GRPO (blue) curve climbs more gradually and remains somewhat lower, reaching approximately 0.8–0.9 by step 300.

In chart (b), "Train/Response Length," the vertical axis ranges from approximately 500 to 900, with tick marks at 500, 600, 700, 800, and 900. The SRPO curve (orange/red) consistently achieves the highest response lengths, rising to approximately 850–900 by the later steps. The SRPO w/o Self-reflection SFT curve (green) follows a similar upward trajectory but at slightly lower values. The GRPO curve (blue) remains the lowest throughout, hovering around 550–650 for much of the training before showing some increase toward the end.

In chart (c), "Train/Ratio Clip Upper," the vertical axis ranges from approximately 0.002 to 0.014, with tick marks at 0.002, 0.004, 0.006, 0.008, 0.010, 0.012, and 0.014. The GRPO curve (blue) exhibits the most volatile behavior, with sharp spikes reaching up to approximately 0.012–0.014, particularly in the early and middle stages of training. The SRPO w/o Self-reflection SFT curve (green) also shows notable fluctuations but generally at lower magnitudes. The SRPO curve (orange/red) remains the lowest and smoothest throughout training, staying mostly below 0.004 and exhibiting minimal spikes. All three line charts display noisy, fluctuating curves characteristic of reinforcement learning training dynamics, and no particular visual emphasis such as bolding or annotation is applied to distinguish any single curve beyond the color coding.
model_annotations.English:
This figure presents three line charts (labeled a, b, and c) showing training curves for SRPO and baseline methods, tracking (a) training reward, (b) response length, and (c) upper clipping ratio over the course of training. Each chart shares the same horizontal axis labeled "Train/Global Steps," spanning from approximately 50 to 300, with tick marks at intervals of 50. Three methods are compared across all panels, distinguished by color in the legend: GRPO (shown in blue), SRPO (shown in orange/red), and SRPO w/o Self-reflection SFT (shown in green).

In chart (a), "Train/Reward," the vertical axis ranges from approximately 0.5 to 1.0. All three curves start at different initial values and generally trend upward. GRPO begins lowest around 0.5–0.6 and rises to roughly 0.8–0.85 by step 300. SRPO w/o Self-reflection SFT starts around 0.6–0.65 and climbs to approximately 0.85–0.9. SRPO starts highest at roughly 0.7–0.75 and reaches values near 0.9–0.95 by the end of training, exhibiting the highest reward throughout.

In chart (b), "Train/Response Length," the vertical axis ranges from approximately 500 to 900. GRPO starts around 500–550 and gradually increases to roughly 650–700. SRPO w/o Self-reflection SFT begins near 550 and rises to approximately 700–750. SRPO consistently shows the longest responses, starting around 600–650 and increasing to approximately 800–900 by step 300.

In chart (c), "Train/Ratio Clip Upper," the vertical axis ranges from approximately 0.002 to 0.014. GRPO shows the most volatile and highest values, fluctuating between roughly 0.006 and 0.014. SRPO w/o Self-reflection SFT displays moderate values and variability, generally ranging between 0.004 and 0.010. SRPO exhibits the lowest and smoothest curve, remaining relatively stable between approximately 0.002 and 0.006 throughout training. All three curves show noisy fluctuations characteristic of RL training, but SRPO's clipping ratio curve is visibly smoother and lower than the other two methods. The bars and lines are not sorted in any particular order beyond the temporal progression of training steps.
model_annotations.German: Dieses Diagramm, bezeichnet als „Figure 4", zeigt Trainingskurven für SRPO und Baselines in drei Teildiagrammen: (a) Training Reward, (b) Response Length und (c) Upper Clipping Ratio. Alle drei Teildiagramme verwenden die horizontale Achse zur Darstellung der „Train/Global Steps" mit einer linearen Skala, die von etwa 50 bis 300 reicht, mit Tick-Beschriftungen bei 50, 100, 150, 200, 250 und 300. Jedes Teildiagramm enthält drei Kurven, die in der Legende als „GRPO" (blau), „SRPO" (orange) und „SRPO w/o Self-reflection SFT" (grün) gekennzeichnet sind. Im Teildiagramm (a) ist die vertikale Achse mit „Train/Reward" beschriftet und reicht von etwa 0,5 bis 1,0, mit Tick-Beschriftungen bei 0,5, 0,6, 0,7, 0,8, 0,9 und 1,0; die SRPO-Kurve (orange) und die SRPO w/o Self-reflection SFT-Kurve (grün) steigen schneller an und erreichen höhere Werte von etwa 0,9 bis 1,0, während die GRPO-Kurve (blau) langsamer ansteigt und bei niedrigeren Werten um etwa 0,7 bis 0,8 verbleibt. Im Teildiagramm (b) ist die vertikale Achse mit „Train/Response Length" beschriftet und reicht von etwa 500 bis 900, mit Tick-Beschriftungen bei 500, 600, 700, 800 und 900; die SRPO-Kurve (orange) zeigt die höchsten Werte und steigt auf etwa 850 bis 900, die SRPO w/o Self-reflection SFT-Kurve (grün) liegt im mittleren Bereich um 700 bis 800, und die GRPO-Kurve (blau) verbleibt bei niedrigeren Werten um 550 bis 650. Im Teildiagramm (c) ist die vertikale Achse mit „Train/Ratio Clip Upper" beschriftet und reicht von etwa 0,002 bis 0,014, mit Tick-Beschriftungen bei 0,002, 0,004, 0,006, 0,008, 0,010, 0,012 und 0,014; die GRPO-Kurve (blau) zeigt die höchsten und volatilsten Werte mit Spitzen bis etwa 0,012 bis 0,014, die SRPO w/o Self-reflection SFT-Kurve (grün) liegt im mittleren Bereich, und die SRPO-Kurve (orange) zeigt die niedrigsten und glattesten Werte, die überwiegend unter 0,006 bleiben. Alle Kurven weisen deutliche Schwankungen auf, wobei keine explizite Sortierung der Linien vorliegt und keine Balken, sondern Liniendiagramme mit kontinuierlichen Verläufen dargestellt werden.
